Environment.description: The environment a recipe ran in, named by an IRI.

iri.description: An absolute IRI naming exactly that environment, enough for its runner, at the version the record gives, to recreate it. It need not resolve online: a `urn:` IRI or a scheme of the runner's own will do, such as `urn:example-runner:env:sha256:…`.

Environment.title: Environment

Generation.description: A run of an output's recipe: the commit it ran from, what it read, the environment it ran in and the runner that ran it.

commit.description: The full id of the git commit the recipe ran from. It pins every file of the code and every `astra.yaml`, an analysis in a submodule through the commit the submodule is pinned at.

environment.description: The environment the recipe ran in.

finished.description: When the recipe finished, in UTC to the millisecond, such as `2026-10-26T14:00:02.000Z`.

inputs.description: What the recipe read: one item for each entry the output's `inputs` lists, matched by `entry`; the order of the items carries no meaning.

runner.description: The runner that ran the recipe.

started.description: When the recipe started, in UTC to the millisecond, such as `2026-10-26T14:00:00.000Z`.

Generation.title: Generation

RecordedInput.description: One of the output's inputs, as the recipe read it: the entry, and the content hash and size of what the recipe read through it.

content_hash.description: The SHA-256 digest of what the recipe read through the entry: another output's result, or the file an input names.

entry.description: The entry exactly as the output's `inputs` lists it in the `astra.yaml`, such as `root.data`.

size.description: The size of what the recipe read through the entry, in bytes.

RecordedInput.title: RecordedInput

Runner.description: The software that ran the recipe and wrote the record.

id.description: The runner's name, ideally unique (an IRI, say), such as `example-runner`.

Runner.title: Runner

description: The provenance of one result, which the runner that made it writes as JSON: what the result is and the run of the recipe that made it.

address.description: The result as the analysis it belongs to addresses it: the output's id, after the ids of the declared analyses that lead to it, then `#` and the universe's id when the result is built in a universe, such as `subanalysis1.output1#u1`.

content_hash.description: The SHA-256 digest of the result's bytes.

generated_by.description: The run of the recipe that made the result.

size.description: The size of the result, in bytes.

spec_version.description: The version of the ASTRA specification the record follows, such as `0.1.0`.

title: provenance
